format: Markdown (MD) document with embedded technical content
description: This file documents the 'Composite Input HAL Interface' for a platform, including overview, functional features, system context, discovery patterns, state machines, capabilities, API interactions, event handling, telemetry, property querying, and implementation guidance. It serves as a comprehensive technical specification and reference guide for developers implementing or interacting with the HAL.

classes.name: ICompositeInputManager
classes.description: Interface for managing and discovering composite input ports.

classes.name: ICompositeInputPort
classes.description: Interface representing individual composite input ports, supporting control, capability queries, and telemetry.

classes.name: IPortEventListener
classes.description: Callback interface for receiving port event notifications (connection, signal, video mode changes).

classes.name: IPortTelemetryListener
classes.description: Callback interface for receiving telemetry and metrics updates.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Data class describing capabilities and supported properties for a specific port.

classes.name: Port
classes.description: Metadata representing a port’s identity, name, and description.

classes.name: SignalStatus
classes.description: Enum representing signal status states: NO_SIGNAL, UNSTABLE, STABLE, NOT_SUPPORTED.

classes.name: VideoResolution
classes.description: Parcelable type describing video resolution and format, including interlaced information.

classes.name: PortMetrics
classes.description: Telemetry data class including lock time, drops, uptime, and last reset timestamp.

classes.name: PropertyKVPair
classes.description: Key-value pair for batch property retrieval or setting.

classes.name: PropertyMetadata
classes.description: Metadata describing property types, read-only status, and descriptions.

classes.name: PlatformCapabilities
classes.description: Descriptor for platform-wide feature flags and supported capabilities.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Returns a list of available port IDs for enumeration.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves an ICompositeInputPort interface for a specific port ID.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Returns platform-wide capabilities and support flags.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers an event listener for connection, signal, and video mode events.

methods.name: registerTelemetryListener
methods.description: Registers a telemetry listener for metrics updates on supported ports.

methods.name: getPortCapabilities
methods.description: Queries capabilities and supported properties of a port.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value by key.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the port for video presentation.
